name: Victoria Falls Town
tagline: The compact centre, fifteen minutes from the falls
description: The small grid of streets holding the shops, tour operators, restaurants and the colonial-era Victoria Falls Hotel, with the entrance to the falls a fifteen-minute walk away. Warthogs and elephants on the roads are a routine part of it.
bestFor: Anyone who wants to walk to the falls and the tour operators
pros: All the operators and restaurants together
The Victoria Falls Hotel and its terrace
cons: Persistent touting on the main street
Wildlife on the streets is a genuine hazard

name: Chinotimba
tagline: The residential township, and where the prices are real
description: The town's residential area west of the centre, where most of the people who work in the tourism industry actually live, with its own market, bars and food at Zimbabwean rather than visitor prices. It is a working neighbourhood.
bestFor: Long stays at genuinely local prices
pros: A fraction of the cost of the tourist centre
Local market and real food prices
Twenty minutes on foot to the centre

name: The Zambezi Riverfront
description: The stretch of river above the falls, west of the town, lined with lodges and camps looking across the water into Zambia, with hippos and elephants along the bank and the sunset cruises leaving from here every evening.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the river and the wildlife at the door
cons: A vehicle or transfers are needed
Hippos and elephants are a real hazard at night

name: Livingstone
tagline: The Zambian side, across the bridge
description: The town on the Zambian bank, eleven kilometres from the falls rather than beside them, larger and more of a real town than Victoria Falls. The KAZA UniVisa makes crossing back and forth routine, and Devil's Pool is on this side.
bestFor: Anyone using the UniVisa to treat both sides as one place
pros: Cheaper and more of a working town
Devil's Pool and the Zambian viewpoints
Crossing is routine with the UniVisa
cons: Eleven kilometres from the falls themselves
A separate country with its own paperwork
